shellCommands.command: cat package.json && echo ---- && git ls-files && echo ---- && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.agents' | head -50

for f in src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo "=== node_modules"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo "=== TRAPS theming"; rg -n -i -C 4 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme/ && echo "=== ThemeProvider.d.ts"; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo "=== types"; cat build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; echo "=== useTheme"; cat build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== theme index"; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo "=== Switch"; cat build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo "=== Control types"; rg -n 'checked|onUpdate|onChange|size|content' build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup"; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

echo "=== Text"; rg -n 'variant|TextProps|TEXT_VARIANTS|TextVariant' build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== Flex"; rg -n 'direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap' build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Card"; rg -n 'view|type|size|theme' build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== Label"; rg -n 'theme|size' build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -10
